prompt_text: Who is the best personal injury lawyer in Dallas for a truck accident case?
answer_verbatim:
There isn’t one objectively “best” lawyer for every truck accident — the right attorney depends on your case details and what you value (trial experience, high-value settlements, local knowledge, communication style). I can help you find a top lawyer in Dallas, but first here are practical criteria and next steps so you can pick the best fit:

What to look for
- Substantial truck-accident experience (tractor-trailers/commercial carriers). Trucking cases have special rules (FMCSA, hours-of-service, maintenance/inspection records).
- Trial experience and a record of large settlements/verdicts. Many trucking defendants are insured/heavily defended; you want someone who will litigate if needed.
- Resources to hire accident reconstructionists, medical experts, and to advance case costs.
- Board certification: Texas Board of Legal Specialization certification in Personal Injury Trial Law is a strong credential.
- Good client reviews and peer ratings (Martindale-Hubbell AV, Super Lawyers, Best Lawyers) and local reputation in Dallas courts.
- Clear contingency-fee agreement (no upfront fee; attorney takes percentage of recovery) and transparent fee/cost policies.
- Accessibility and communication style you prefer.

Questions to ask at a free consultation
- How many truck-accident cases like mine have you handled? What were the outcomes?
- Have you tried a truck-accident case to verdict in Dallas County (or federal court if applicable)?
- Do you have experience handling claims against large carriers/companies?
- Will you handle my case personally or give it to staff/associates?
- What experts will you use (accident reconstruction, biomechanics, medical)?
- How do you charge (contingency %, who pays costs if we don’t recover)?
- Can you provide references (past clients or results)?

Documents to bring for an initial consult
- Police report, photos of the crash/vehicles/injuries, dashcam/cell video if any
- Insurance information for all parties
- Medical records and bills related to the crash
- Employer/vehicle info if the truck was commercial (company name, DOT/MC number if known)
- Any correspondence from insurance companies

Red flags
- Guarantees of a specific dollar outcome
- Reluctance to put fee terms in writing
- No experience with truck carriers or no plan to use experts

How I can help next
- If you want, tell me your ZIP code and a few case details (injuries, liability dispute, whether the truck was commercial). I can then suggest how to find top-rated Dallas lawyers and help you evaluate specific names you’ve found.
- I can also draft an email or list of questions to send to lawyers you’re considering.

If you’d like immediate specific names, tell me your ZIP code and any preferences (trial focus, size of firm, languages), and I’ll give a short list of well-qualified Dallas attorneys/firms to contact.
